# Addendum E1 run log (dated entries; written before any external result was seen)

- **2026-11-12 12:26 UTC, ZCHSound source.** The project website (zchsound.ncrcch.org.cn) redirected to a DNS-provider page and could not be used. The dataset was downloaded from the first author's official GitHub repository (github.com/WeiJieOvO/ZCHSound-Dataset, Git LFS object `ZCHSound.zip`, 339,554,986 bytes). Its SHA-256 (112432cb10c5ab768cabf217f0a090a20bd0102b093d8b42dbdabc19e39b58b7) matched the LFS pointer. Licence: the README refers to the paper and the project site; the paper states the data are publicly downloadable.
- **ZCHSound structure.** 941 clean and 318 noisy recordings, one per participant, at 8 kHz, PCM-16, about 15–20 s each. Metadata: file name, sex, age (days), diagnosis. Some noisy files are 2-channel; these are averaged to mono before the frozen preprocessing (implementation detail, not in the addendum text). Age groups follow the CirCor definitions: clean subset 9 neonates, 259 infants, 654 children, 19 adolescents; noisy subset all neonates.
- **Blinding.** The scoring stage reads only `external/zchsound_manifest.csv` (unit, recording, path). Labels are in `external/zchsound_labels.csv` and are read only by `run_external.py analyse`. Diagnosis counts were visible in the metadata during adapter construction; no model output had been produced at that time.
- **2026-11-12 12:45 UTC, PASCAL B source.** The official challenge sites (peterjbentley.com, istethoscope.peterjbentley.com) were unreachable. The TU Berlin mldata mirror served a truncated archive (50,003,981 bytes, SHA-256 adb0055e…a4fc) containing only dataset A, so it is not usable for dataset B. The remaining source is the Kaggle copy (kinguistics/heartbeat-sounds), which requires the author to sign in. Decision pending: use the Kaggle copy (third-party re-upload, recorded as such) or drop PASCAL B under addendum section 2.
- **2026-11-12 14:10 UTC, PASCAL B dropped.** The author decided not to use the Kaggle re-upload because its provenance cannot be verified against an official source. No other copy of dataset B was obtainable. Under addendum section 2, PASCAL B is dropped and the reason reported. No PASCAL B data were downloaded or scored. ZCHSound is the only external dataset.
- **2026-11-12 14:13–14:52 UTC, scoring.** `run_external.bat` scored all 1,125 frozen models on 1,259 ZCHSound recordings (0 unreadable). Labels were not read.
- **2026-11-12 15:00 UTC, analysis.** `run_external.py analyse` was run for the registered subsets: clean (primary), clean without PFO (sensitivity analysis) and noisy (descriptive). A `--tag` option and a descriptive subgroup table (by subset, diagnosis and age group) were added to the analysis stage only; the scoring stage was unchanged. Outputs and SHA-256 manifests are in `results/external/zchsound_<tag>_*`.
